title: Tajriba bo‘lishish: 2 daqiqalik monolog
goal_uz: Dars oxirida bir daqiqalik reja bilan o‘z tajribangiz haqida to‘rt qadamli tuzilma, vaqt iboralari va bog‘lovchilar yordamida to‘xtamasdan ikki daqiqa gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Ikki daqiqalik monologga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say: Welcome! Last time you learned useful collocations. Today you will use them to speak alone for two full minutes about something that happened to you.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan so‘z birikmalarini o‘rgandik. Bugun ularni ikki daqiqa to‘xtamasdan gapirish uchun ishlatamiz. Ko‘pchilik o‘ylaydigan narsa shuki, uzoq gapirish uchun juda boy lug‘at kerak. Aslida rejalash va tuzilma kerak. Dars oxirida o‘z tajribangiz haqida bir daqiqalik reja bilan ikki daqiqalik monolog aytishga tayyor bo‘lasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan darsda foydali so‘z birikmalarini o‘rgandik. Bugun ularni boshingizdan o‘tgan voqea haqida ikki daqiqa gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.

scenes.title: Nega reja kerak?
scenes.say: Without a plan, most speakers stop after thirty seconds or repeat themselves. With one minute of planning, you know where you are going.
scenes.say_native: Rejasiz gapirsangiz, odatda o‘ttiz soniyadan keyin to‘xtab qolasiz yoki bir gapni takrorlaysiz. Chunki miyangiz bir vaqtning o‘zida nima deyishni, qanday deyishni va grammatikani o‘ylashi kerak. Bir daqiqalik reja bu yukni yengillashtiradi: siz yo‘lni oldindan bilasiz. Ingliz tili imtihonlarida, masalan IELTS speaking da, aynan shunday: bir daqiqa tayyorgarlik, keyin bir-ikki daqiqa monolog. Bu ko‘nikma ish suhbatida va hayotda ham kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Rejasiz ko‘pchilik o‘ttiz soniyadan keyin to‘xtaydi yoki o‘zini takrorlaydi. Bir daqiqalik reja yo‘lni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Bir daqiqalik reja usuli
board: 0:00–0:10 Read the card, choose ONE story
scenes.say: Use your minute well. Ten seconds to choose a story, thirty seconds to make notes, and twenty seconds to choose key phrases.
scenes.say_native: Bir daqiqani shunday taqsimlang. Dastlabki o‘n soniyada kartani o‘qib, bitta voqeani tanlang, eng qiziq voqeani emas, o‘zingiz tafsilotlarini yaxshi biladigan voqeani. Keyingi o‘ttiz soniyada to‘rtta katakka qisqa yozuv yozing. Oxirgi yigirma soniyada uchta foydali birikma va bitta bog‘lovchini belgilab qo‘ying. Yozuvlar faqat kalit so‘zlardan iborat bo‘lsin, to‘liq gap yozmang, chunki vaqt yetmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n soniya voqeani tanlash, o‘ttiz soniya yozuv, yigirma soniya kalit iboralarni belgilash uchun.

scenes.title: Namunaviy karta va reja
board: Card: Describe a time you learned something new.

examples.t: I learned to swim at twenty-five.
examples.uz: Men yigirma besh yoshda suzishni o‘rgandim.

scenes.say: Here is a card: describe a time you learned something new. The notes are only keywords: swimming, twenty-five, coach, fear, proud, never too late.
scenes.say_native: Mana karta: yangi narsani o‘rgangan paytingizni tasvirlang. Namunaviy reja: birinchi katak, vaziyat — suzish, yigirma besh yosh, shahar basseyni. Ikkinchi katak, tafsilotlar — murabbiy, qo‘rquv, birinchi dars. Uchinchi katak, his-tuyg‘ular — avval qo‘rqdim, keyin faxrlandim. To‘rtinchi katak, xulosa — hech qachon kech emas. Ko‘ryapsizmi, hammasi bir necha kalit so‘zdan iborat, to‘liq gap yo‘q.
scenes.say_uz: Karta: yangi narsani o‘rgangan paytingiz. Yozuvlar kalit so‘zlar: suzish, yigirma besh, murabbiy, qo‘rquv, faxr, hech qachon kech emas.

scenes.title: Reja tuzishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Choosing a story you can't describe
scenes.say: Three planning mistakes. Do not write full sentences, do not memorise a script, and do not choose a story that you cannot describe in detail.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: to‘liq gaplar yozish, bir daqiqada ulgurmaysiz va o‘qish gapirish emas. Ikkinchisi: matnni yodlash. Yodlangan nutq sun’iy eshitiladi va bitta so‘z esdan chiqsa, butunlay to‘xtab qolasiz. Uchinchisi: yaxshi eshitiladigan, lekin tafsiloti yo‘q voqeani tanlash. Ikki daqiqa to‘ldirish uchun ko‘rgan, eshitgan, his qilgan narsalaringiz bo‘lishi kerak. Shuning uchun haqiqatan o‘zingiz bilgan voqeani tanlang.
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq gap yozmang, matnni yodlamang va tafsiloti yo‘q voqeani tanlamang.

scenes.title: O‘z rejangizni tuzing
board: Card: Describe a time you helped someone.
scenes.say: Now you plan. The card says: describe a time you helped someone. You have one minute. Make four boxes with keywords only.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz. Karta: kimgadir yordam bergan paytingizni tasvirlang. Sizda bir daqiqa bor. Dastlab o‘n soniyada voqeani tanlang, keyin to‘rtta katakni kalit so‘zlar bilan to‘ldiring: vaziyat, tafsilotlar, his-tuyg‘ular, xulosa. Soat qo‘ying va vaqtga rioya qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Karta: kimgadir yordam bergan paytingiz. Bir daqiqada to‘rtta katakni kalit so‘zlar bilan to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy reja
board: 1 Situation: neighbour, heavy bags, last winter
scenes.say: A model plan: situation, an elderly neighbour with heavy bags last winter. Details, icy stairs and carrying the bags. Feelings, worried then relieved. Reflection, small help matters.
scenes.say_native: Namuna reja: birinchi katak — qo‘shni, og‘ir sumkalar, o‘tgan qish. Ikkinchi katak — muzlagan zinapoya, men sumkalarni ko‘tarib chiqdim. Uchinchi katak — avval xavotir, keyin yengillik, xursandlik. To‘rtinchi — kichik yordam ham muhim. Sizning rejangiz boshqacha bo‘lishi tabiiy. Muhimi: to‘rtala katak to‘la, har birida kamida ikkitadan kalit so‘z bor va voqea mantiqiy tartibda.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: qo‘shni, og‘ir sumkalar, muzlagan zinapoya, xavotir va yengillik, kichik yordam ham muhim.

scenes.title: Tuzilma: to‘rt qadam
scenes.say: A two-minute story has four steps: situation, details, feelings and reflection. About thirty seconds, fifty, twenty and twenty.
scenes.say_native: Ikki daqiqalik hikoya to‘rt qadamdan iborat. Birinchi: vaziyat, taxminan o‘ttiz soniya, ya’ni qachon, qayerda, kim bilan va nima bo‘ldi. Ikkinchi: tafsilotlar, taxminan ellik soniya, bu eng uzun qism. Uchinchi: his-tuyg‘ular, yigirma soniya. To‘rtinchi: xulosa, ya’ni bundan nima o‘rgandingiz, yana yigirma soniya. Bu taqsimot sizga vaqtni boshqarish imkonini beradi. Ko‘pchilik vaziyatni haddan tashqari cho‘zib yuboradi va oxirini ulgurmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt qadam: vaziyat, tafsilot, his-tuyg‘u, xulosa. Taxminan o‘ttiz, ellik, yigirma va yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Birinchi qadam: vaziyat
board: I'd like to tell you about ...
I was ... with ... / The reason was ...

examples.t: I'd like to tell you about a time I got lost in Istanbul.
examples.uz: Sizga Istanbulda adashgan paytim haqida aytib bermoqchiman.

scenes.say: Open with a sentence that names the topic, then say when and where, then who was there. I'd like to tell you about a time when I got lost in Istanbul.
scenes.say_native: Ochilish gapi mavzuni aytib berishi kerak. Foydali qoliplar: “I’d like to tell you about ...” — sizga ... haqida aytib bermoqchiman. Keyin vaqt va joy: “It happened two summers ago”. Keyin kim bilan: “I was with my cousin”. Agar rejangizdagi hikoyani darhol boshlasangiz, tinglovchi adashib qoladi. Shuning uchun avval fonni bering. Bu qismni o‘ttiz soniyadan uzaytirmang, chunki asosiy gap tafsilotlarda.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzuni ayting, keyin vaqt va joyni, keyin kim bilan ekaningizni. Bu qismni qisqa tuting.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi qadam: tafsilotlar va zamonlar

examples.t: It was raining, so I ran into a shop.
examples.uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi, shuning uchun do‘konga yugurib kirdim.

examples.t: I had never seen a crowd like that.
examples.uz: Men bunday olomonni hech ko‘rmagan edim.

scenes.say: Use the past simple for main events, the past continuous for the background, and the past perfect for something that happened earlier.
scenes.say_native: Tafsilotlarda zamonlarni to‘g‘ri aralashtirish nutqingizni boy qiladi. Past simple — asosiy voqealar: I ran into a shop. Past continuous — fon: it was raining. Past perfect — oldinroq bo‘lgan voqea: I had never seen a crowd like that. Odatlar uchun used to yoki would. O‘zbekchada “edi” va “gan edi” bilan bu farqni sezgan bo‘lsangiz kerak. Faqat past simple da gapirsangiz, tushunarli, lekin zerikarli bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Past simple — voqealar, past continuous — fon, past perfect — oldingi voqea, used to — odatlar.

scenes.title: Uchinchi qadam: his-tuyg‘ular
scenes.say: Name the feeling and show it. I was terrified is a name. My heart was pounding is a picture. Use both.
scenes.say_native: His-tuyg‘ular qismi hikoyaga jon kiritadi. Ikkita yo‘l bor: tuyg‘uni nomlash — I was thrilled, terrified, relieved, va uni ko‘rsatish — my heart was pounding, it felt like a dream. “Very happy” o‘rniga thrilled yoki delighted ishlating. Eslatma: surprised kabi -ed bilan tugagan sifatlar sizning holatingizni ifodalaydi, -ing li sifatlar esa narsani tasvirlaydi: I was bored, it was boring. Imtihonda bu farq doim tekshiriladi.
scenes.say_uz: Tuyg‘uni nomlang va ko‘rsating. I was terrified va my heart was pounding. -ed sifat holatni, -ing sifat narsani tasvirlaydi.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi qadam: xulosa
board: If I could do it again, I would ...

examples.t: Looking back, it was the best decision I ever made.
examples.uz: Orqaga qarasam, bu men qilgan eng yaxshi qaror edi.

examples.t: It taught me that it's never too late.
examples.uz: Bu menga hech qachon kech emasligini o‘rgatdi.

scenes.say: Finish with a reflection, not with stop. Looking back, it was the best decision. It taught me that it is never too late.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik hikoyani “That’s all” deb tugatadi. Bu zaif yakun. Yaxshi monolog xulosa bilan tugaydi: “Looking back, ...” — orqaga qarasam; “It taught me that ...” — bu menga ... ni o‘rgatdi; “If I could do it again, I would ...” — qaytadan qilsam, ... qilgan bo‘lardim. Xulosa tinglovchiga voqeaning nega muhimligini ko‘rsatadi va nutqingiz professional eshitiladi. Oxirida minnatdorchilik bildirish shart emas.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoyani xulosa bilan tugating, That's all bilan emas. Looking back va it taught me that foydali iboralar.

scenes.title: Faqat faktlar, his-tuyg‘usiz
board: ✗ I went. I saw. I came back. That's all.
✓ I was nervous, but looking back, it taught me ...
✗ I was boring. → ✓ I was bored.
✗ It was very surprised. → ✓ It was surprising.
scenes.say: Two common problems. A story with facts only and no feelings. And mixing -ed and -ing adjectives: I was bored, the film was boring.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: hikoya faqat faktlardan iborat, his-tuyg‘u va xulosa yo‘q. Bunday monolog ma’lumotnomaga o‘xshaydi. Ikkinchisi: -ed va -ing sifatlarni aralashtirish. “I was boring” degani “men zerikarli odamman”, “I was bored” esa “men zerikdim”. O‘zbek tilida bu farq bitta so‘z bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun adashasiz. Qoida: his qilgan odam uchun -ed, sabab bo‘lgan narsa uchun -ing.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat faktlar yetmaydi. -ed sifat his qilgan odam uchun, -ing sifat sabab bo‘lgan narsa uchun.

scenes.title: Qaysi qadamga tegishli?
board: 1) It happened last summer in Samarkand.
3) The guide was explaining the history.
4) It taught me to stay calm.
scenes.say: Match each sentence to a step: situation, details, feelings or reflection. One: It happened last summer in Samarkand. Two: My heart was pounding. Three: The guide was explaining the history. Four: It taught me to stay calm.
scenes.say_native: Har bir gap to‘rt qadamdan qaysi biriga tegishli? Vaziyat, tafsilot, his-tuyg‘u yoki xulosa. Birinchi: it happened last summer in Samarkand. Ikkinchi: my heart was pounding. Uchinchi: the guide was explaining the history. To‘rtinchi: it taught me to stay calm. Javobingizni ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gap qaysi qadamga tegishli?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: situation. Two: feelings. Three: details. Four: reflection.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gap — vaziyat, chunki unda vaqt va joy bor. Ikkinchi — his-tuyg‘u. Uchinchi — tafsilot, bu yerda past davomiy zamon fonni beryapti. To‘rtinchi — xulosa, chunki “it taught me” iborasi bor. Endi shu qadamlarni bir-biriga ulaydigan so‘zlarga o‘tamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: vaziyat. Ikki: his-tuyg‘u. Uch: tafsilot. To‘rt: xulosa.

scenes.title: Vaqt iboralari
board: First of all, / To begin with,

examples.t: To begin with, I didn't know anyone.
By the time we arrived, it was dark.
examples.uz: Biz yetib kelganimizda qorong‘i bo‘lib qolgan edi.

scenes.say: Time phrases guide the listener: to begin with, a couple of years ago, at that point, meanwhile, by the time, eventually and in the end.
scenes.say_native: Vaqt iboralari tinglovchini hikoya bo‘ylab yetaklaydi. Boshlash uchun: first of all, to begin with. O‘tgan vaqt: a couple of years ago. Voqea o‘rtasida: at that point — o‘sha paytda, meanwhile — shu orada, by the time — ... ga kelib. Yakunlash uchun: eventually — oxir-oqibat, in the end — nihoyat. Faqat “then” va “after that” ni takrorlamang. Har bir ibora ikki-uch marta ishlatilsa, ritm paydo bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqt iboralari: to begin with, a couple of years ago, at that point, meanwhile, by the time, eventually, in the end.

scenes.title: Sabab, zidlik va qo‘shimcha
board: What's more, / On top of that,

examples.t: Even so, I decided to continue.
examples.uz: Shunga qaramay, davom etishga qaror qildim.

scenes.say: Linkers show relationships. Because of that gives a result, however shows contrast, what's more adds a point, and luckily or surprisingly show your attitude.
scenes.say_native: Bog‘lovchilar fikrlar orasidagi munosabatni ko‘rsatadi. “Because of that” va “that’s why” — natija. “However” va “even so” — zidlik. “What’s more” va “on top of that” — qo‘shimcha ma’lumot. “Luckily” va “surprisingly” — sizning munosabatingiz. Bu so‘zlarni gap boshiga qo‘ying va ularning ortidan vergul qo‘ying. Oldingi darsimizdagi although va despite ham mos keladi. Bog‘lovchilarsiz monolog bo‘laklarga bo‘linib qoladi.
scenes.say_uz: Because of that natijani, however zidlikni, what's more qo'shimchani, luckily esa munosabatni ko'rsatadi.

scenes.title: And then, and then
board: ✗ and then ... and then ... and then
✗ At the end I was happy.
✓ In the end I was happy.
scenes.say: Avoid repeating and then. Also do not confuse in the end, which means finally, with at the end, which needs of something.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: “and then” ni qayta-qayta takrorlash. O‘zbekchada “keyin, keyin” deb gapirish odatiy, lekin inglizchada bu bolalarcha eshitiladi. Vaqt iboralarini almashtiring. Ikkinchisi: “at the end” va “in the end” ni aralashtirish. “In the end” — oxir-oqibat, “at the end of the film” esa filmning oxirida, ya’ni aniq narsaning oxirida. “At the end I was happy” deb aytib bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: And then ni takrorlamang. In the end oxir-oqibat degani; at the end of something esa biror narsaning oxirida.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchi tanlang
board: 2) ___ we arrived, the shop had closed. (by ...)
scenes.say: Choose a linker. One: To begin with. Two: By the time. Three: However or even so. Four: Luckily. Say each full sentence.
scenes.say_native: Har bir bo‘sh joyga mos bog‘lovchi tanlang. Birinchi: boshlash uchun. Ikkinchi: ... ga kelib. Uchinchi: zidlik uchun. To‘rtinchi: baxtimga. To‘liq gapni ayting. Variantlar bir nechta bo‘lishi mumkin, o‘zingizga eng tabiiy ko‘ringanini tanlang.
scenes.say_uz: Mos bog‘lovchi tanlang va gapni to‘liq ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: To begin with, I didn't know anyone. Two: By the time we arrived, the shop had closed. Three: However, I smiled. Four: Luckily, a stranger helped me.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. To begin with, I didn’t know anyone. By the time we arrived, the shop had closed. Ikkinchi gapda “had closed” ga e’tibor bering, chunki do‘kon biz yetib kelishimizdan oldin yopilgan. Uchinchi: however yoki even so. To‘rtinchi: luckily. Bu iboralarni monologingizdan oldin rejadagi “linker” katagiga yozib qo‘ying.
scenes.say_uz: To begin with. By the time. However yoki even so. Luckily.

scenes.title: Tinglash: namunaviy monolog, birinchi qism
board: Maya talks about losing her luggage in Rome.
scenes.say: I'd like to tell you about a time I lost my luggage in Rome. It happened two summers ago. I was travelling alone, and when I got to the carousel, my suitcase simply wasn't there. At that point I felt sick. I had packed everything I needed for a job interview the next day.
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq monologning birinchi qismini tinglang. Mayya Rimda yukini yo‘qotgani haqida gapiryapti. U avval mavzuni aytadi, keyin vaqtni, so‘ng vaziyatni tasvirlaydi. “At that point” iborasi va “had packed” kabi o‘tgan zamon shakli sizga tanish. Hikoyada nima muammo bo‘lganini va nima uchun u qo‘rqqanini payqang.
scenes.say_uz: Men Rimda yukimni yo‘qotgan paytim haqida aytib bermoqchiman. Bu ikki yoz oldin bo‘ldi. Yolg‘iz sayohat qilardim va yuk lentasiga kelganimda chemodanim yo‘q edi. O‘sha paytda o‘zimni yomon his qildim. Ertangi ish suhbati uchun kerakli hamma narsani joylagan edim.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ikkinchi qism
board: Maya: The rest of the story.
scenes.say: Luckily, an airport worker listened calmly and said the bag had gone to Milan by mistake. Even so, I was terrified. In the end, it arrived at my hotel at midnight. Looking back, it taught me to keep spare clothes in my hand luggage, and to stay calm.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi qism. Mayya hikoyani davom ettiradi. Baxtimga, aeroport xodimi xotirjam tinglagan va yuk adashib boshqa shaharga ketganini aytgan. Mayya baribir qo‘rqqan. Oxir-oqibat yuk mehmonxonaga yarim tunda kelgan. Xulosada u nimani o‘rganganini aytadi. Tinglang va bog‘lovchilarni sanab chiqing.
scenes.say_uz: Baxtimga, aeroport xodimi xotirjam tinglab, chemodan adashib Milanga ketganini aytdi. Shunga qaramay, men juda qo‘rqdim. Oxir-oqibat u yarim tunda mehmonxonaga yetib keldi. Orqaga qarasam, bu menga qo‘l yukida ehtiyot kiyim olib yurishni va xotirjam bo‘lishni o‘rgatdi.

scenes.title: Mayya haqida savollar
scenes.say: Answer five questions. One: where did the story happen? Two: why was the luggage important? Three: where had the bag gone? Four: what did Maya learn? Five: name three linkers.
scenes.say_native: Beshta savol. Birinchi: voqea qayerda bo‘lgan? Ikkinchi: yuk nima uchun muhim edi? Uchinchi: chemodan qayerga ketib qolgan edi? To‘rtinchi: Mayya nimani o‘rgandi? Beshinchi: uchta bog‘lovchini ayting. To‘liq inglizcha gaplar bilan javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: Beshta savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) Keep spare clothes in hand luggage; stay calm.
5) At that point, luckily, even so, in the end, looking back
scenes.say: One: in Rome. Two: it had her clothes for a job interview. Three: to Milan. Four: to keep spare clothes in her hand luggage and to stay calm. Five: for example luckily, even so and in the end.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Rimda. Ikkinchi: unda ish suhbati uchun kiyimlari bor edi. Uchinchi: Milanga. To‘rtinchi: qo‘l yukida ehtiyot kiyim olib yurish va xotirjam bo‘lish. Beshinchi: at that point, luckily, even so, in the end, looking back — ulardan uchtasini aytsangiz yetarli. Ko‘rdingizmi, ikki daqiqalik monolog aslida shu to‘rt qadam va bir nechta bog‘lovchidan iborat.
scenes.say_uz: Rimda. Ish suhbati uchun kiyimlari bor edi. Milanga. Ehtiyot kiyim olib yurish va xotirjam qolish. Luckily, even so, in the end.

scenes.title: To‘xtamasdan gapirish: vaqt yutish

examples.t: Well, let me think. It was about six years ago.
examples.uz: Keling, o‘ylab ko‘ray. Bu taxminan olti yil oldin edi.

scenes.say: When you need a moment, use natural fillers: well, let me think, how can I put it, the thing is. These are better than silence or um repeated again and again.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: to‘xtamasdan gapirish. Fikr topish uchun vaqt kerak bo‘lsa, jim turmang. Tabiiy iboralarni ishlating: “Well, let me think”, “How can I put it?”, “The thing is ...”, “What I mean is ...”. Ular ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham doim ishlatadigan iboralar. Ular uzun “eee” lardan yaxshiroq eshitiladi. Faqat har bir gapdan oldin bir xil iborani qo‘ymang, ikki-uch xil variantni almashtiring.
scenes.say_uz: Fikr topish uchun jim turmang: well, let me think, how can I put it, the thing is. Bir xil iborani qayta-qayta ishlatmang.

scenes.title: So‘z esingizdan chiqsa
board: It's a kind of ... that you use to ...

examples.t: It's a thing you use to carry your clothes when you travel.
examples.uz: Bu sayohat paytida kiyimlaringizni olib yuradigan narsa.

examples.t: I went on Monday, or rather, Tuesday.

scenes.say: If you forget a word, describe it: it's a thing you use to... Or use the opposite. If you make an error, correct it quickly: I mean, or rather, sorry I meant, and keep going.
scenes.say_native: So‘z esingizdan chiqsa, to‘xtamang, uni tasvirlang: “It’s a thing you use to carry your clothes” — chemodan. Yoki: “It’s the opposite of ...”. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham shunday qiladi. Xato qilsangiz, tez tuzating: “I mean ...”, “or rather ...”, “sorry, I meant ...”, va davom eting. Uzr so‘rab uzoq to‘xtash va “my English is bad” deyish shart emas. Tinglovchi mazmunga qiziqadi, mukammal grammatikaga emas.
scenes.say_uz: So‘z esdan chiqsa, uni tasvirlang. Xato qilsangiz, I mean yoki or rather bilan tez tuzating va davom eting.

scenes.title: Tafsilot qo‘shish qoidasi
board: Rule: if stuck, add one more detail

examples.t: The room smelled like old books, and the light was golden.
examples.uz: Xona eski kitoblar hidi anqirdi va yorug‘lik oltin rangda edi.

scenes.say: If you run out of things to say, add one more detail: a colour, a place, a sound, what someone said, or a comparison. A detail is better than a pause.
scenes.say_native: Gap tugab qolsa, bitta tafsilot qo‘shing. Rang, joy, tovush, kimdir nima degani yoki nimani o‘ylaganingiz yoki o‘xshatish: “It felt as if time had stopped”. Bu eng oddiy usul va u ikki daqiqani to‘ldirishga eng ko‘p yordam beradi. Tafsilotlar hikoyani jonli ham qiladi. Agar rejangizda uch katak qolgan va vaqt hali bor bo‘lsa, ikkinchi katakka qaytib, qo‘shimcha tafsilot bering.
scenes.say_uz: Gap tugab qolsa, bitta tafsilot qo‘shing: rang, joy, tovush, so‘z yoki o‘xshatish. Tafsilot pauzadan yaxshiroq.

scenes.title: Monologni buzadigan odatlar
scenes.say: Three habits break a monologue. Long silence with repeated apologies. Saying my English is bad. And translating word for word from Uzbek.
scenes.say_native: Uchta odat monologni buzadi. Birinchisi: uzoq jimlik va takroriy uzr. Ikkinchisi: “my English is bad” deyish, bu tinglovchining ishonchini kamaytiradi. Uchinchisi: o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilish: tarjima qilayotganda gapingiz sekinlashadi va g‘alati chiqadi. Buning o‘rniga inglizcha o‘ylashga urining: oddiyroq so‘z toping va davom eting. Oddiy, lekin to‘xtamaydigan nutq murakkab, lekin to‘xtab-to‘xtab aytilgan nutqdan yaxshiroq baho oladi.
scenes.say_uz: Uzoq jimlik, uzr va so‘zma-so‘z tarjima nutqni buzadi. Soddalashtiring va davom eting.

scenes.title: So‘zni tasvirlab bering
scenes.say: Describe each thing without saying the word. One: umbrella. Two: passport. Three: suitcase. For example, it's a thing you use when it rains.
scenes.say_native: Uchta narsani nomini aytmasdan tasvirlang. Birinchi: soyabon. Ikkinchi: pasport. Uchinchi: chemodan. Masalan: “It’s a thing you use when it rains”. Har bir tasvir uchun bir-ikki gap yetarli. Maqsad — to‘xtab qolmaslik. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Narsalarni nomini aytmasdan tasvirlang: soyabon, pasport, chemodan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) It's a thing you use when it rains.
2) It's a document you show at the border.
3) It's a big bag you pack your clothes in.
scenes.say: Possible answers: It's a thing you use when it rains. It's a document you show at the border. It's a big bag you pack your clothes in.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Soyabon: “It’s a thing you use when it rains”. Pasport: “It’s a document you show at the border”. Chemodan: “It’s a big bag you pack your clothes in”. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lsa, yaxshi: har qanday aniq tasvir to‘g‘ri. Muhimi, siz to‘xtamadingiz va tinglovchi nimani nazarda tutganingizni tushundi.
scenes.say_uz: Soyabon: yomg‘irda ishlatiladigan narsa. Pasport: chegarada ko‘rsatiladigan hujjat. Chemodan: kiyim joylanadigan katta sumka.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: bo‘laklar va urg‘u
board: Chunk: I'd like to tell you | about a time | when I got lost.
Slow down for the key moment

examples.t: It was the most TERRIFYING moment of my life.
examples.uz: Bu hayotimdagi eng qo‘rqinchli lahza edi.

scenes.say: Speak in chunks of three to six words with a small pause between them. Stress the important words, and slow down at the key moment of the story.
scenes.say_native: Monologda talaffuz va ritm muhim. Gapni uch-olti so‘zlik bo‘laklarga bo‘ling va orada qisqa to‘xtang: “I’d like to tell you | about a time | when I got lost”. Muhim so‘zlarni kuchliroq ayting: LOST, TERRIFIED. Hikoyaning eng hayajonli joyida sekinlashing va ovoz tonini o‘zgartiring. Bir tekis, tez gapirish tinglovchini charchatadi. Ona tilidagi kabi, voqeaga mos ovoz bilan gapirsangiz, kamchiliklaringiz kamroq sezilar.
scenes.say_uz: Gapni bo‘laklarga bo‘ling, muhim so‘zlarga urg‘u bering va eng hayajonli joyda sekinlashing.

scenes.title: Bo‘laklarga bo‘lib takrorlang
board: I'd like to tell you | about a time | when I lost my luggage.
At that point | I felt sick.
Looking back, | it taught me | to stay calm.
scenes.say: Repeat in chunks. I'd like to tell you, about a time, when I lost my luggage. At that point, I felt sick. Looking back, it taught me, to stay calm.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni bo‘laklarga bo‘lib takrorlang. Vertikal chiziq to‘xtash joyini ko‘rsatadi. Har bir bo‘lakni aniq ayting, to‘xtang va keyingisini ayting. Ovozni mazmuniga mos o‘zgartiring: ikkinchi gapda tashvish, uchinchisida xotirjamlik. Har birini ikki martadan takrorlang.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni bo‘laklarga bo‘lib, to‘xtash va urg‘u bilan takrorlang.

scenes.title: Tinglash: mashg‘ulot oldidan maslahat
board: Student: I said sorry and waited.
scenes.say: Coach: How was your practice? Student: I stopped twice and said sorry. Coach: Next time, use a filler and add a detail. Student: Like, well, the thing is, the room was freezing? Coach: Exactly. Keep going, and always finish with a reflection.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Murabbiy talabadan mashg‘ulot qanday o‘tganini so‘raydi. Talaba ikki marta to‘xtab, uzr so‘raganini aytadi. Murabbiy keyingi safar vaqt yutish iborasi va tafsilot ishlatishni maslahat beradi. Tinglang va murabbiyning uchta maslahatini toping.
scenes.say_uz: Murabbiy: Mashg‘ulot qanday o‘tdi? Talaba: Ikki marta to‘xtadim va uzr so‘radim. Murabbiy: Keyingi safar vaqt yutish iborasi va tafsilot ishlating. Talaba: Masalan, mana, gap shundaki, xona muzlab ketgan edi? Murabbiy: Aynan. Davom eting va doim xulosa bilan tugating.

scenes.title: Maslahatlar nima edi?
board: 1) How many times did the student stop?
2) What did he do when he stopped?
3) What are the coach's three pieces of advice?
scenes.say: Three questions. One: how many times did the student stop? Two: what did he do? Three: what are the coach's pieces of advice?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: talaba necha marta to‘xtadi? Ikkinchi: to‘xtaganda nima qildi? Uchinchi: murabbiyning maslahatlari qanday? Dialogni eslab, to‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: Talaba necha marta to‘xtadi? To‘xtaganda nima qildi? Murabbiyning maslahatlari qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) Use a filler, add a detail, finish with a reflection.
scenes.say: One: twice. Two: he said sorry and waited. Three: use a filler, add a detail and finish with a reflection.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ikki marta. Ikkinchi: u uzr so‘radi va kutib turdi. Uchinchi: vaqt yutish iborasini ishlatish, tafsilot qo‘shish va xulosa bilan tugatish. Bular aynan bugun o‘rgangan narsalarimiz. Shuni yodda tuting: to‘xtash noto‘g‘ri emas, lekin jim turib uzr so‘rash noto‘g‘ri. Tabiiy ibora bilan davom eting.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki marta. Uzr so‘radi va kutdi. Ibora ishlatish, tafsilot qo‘shish, xulosa bilan tugatish.

scenes.title: Toliq namuna: boshlanishi
board: I'd like to tell you about ... / It happened ...
To begin with, ... / At that point, ...
scenes.say: Here is the first minute of a model answer. I'd like to tell you about the first time I gave a speech. It happened two years ago, at my cousin's wedding. To begin with, I was calm. By the time I stood up, my hands were shaking.
scenes.say_native: Mana namunaviy monologning birinchi daqiqasi: “I’d like to tell you about the first time I gave a speech. It happened two years ago, at my cousin’s wedding. To begin with, I was calm. By the time I stood up, my hands were shaking”. Bu yerda ochilish ibora, vaqt, joy, fon va vaqt iboralari bor. Hozircha faqat ellik so‘z, lekin tuzilma tayyor.
scenes.say_uz: Men birinchi marta nutq so‘zlagan paytim haqida aytib bermoqchiman. Bu ikki yil oldin amakivachchamning to‘yida bo‘lgan. Avvaliga xotirjam edim. O‘rnimdan turganimda qo‘llarim titrayotgan edi.

scenes.title: Toliq namuna: davomi
board: I was terrified. / My heart was pounding.
scenes.say: The second part. I was terrified. My heart was pounding. Luckily, I looked at my cousin, and she smiled. I took a deep breath and kept going. Looking back, it taught me that being nervous is normal, and that people forgive small mistakes.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi qism: “I was terrified. My heart was pounding. Luckily, I looked at my cousin, and she smiled. I took a deep breath and kept going. Looking back, it taught me that being nervous is normal, and that people forgive small mistakes”. Bu yerda his-tuyg‘u, baxtimga bog‘lovchisi, birikma take a deep breath va xulosa bor. Ikkala qismni birlashtirib ikki daqiqagacha uzaytirsa bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Men juda qo‘rqdim. Yuragim gursillab urardi. Baxtimga, amakivachchamga qaradim va u jilmaydi. Chuqur nafas olib davom etdim. Orqaga qarasam, bu menga hayajonlanish tabiiy ekanini va odamlar kichik xatolarni kechirishini o‘rgatdi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: ikki daqiqa gapiring
board: Card: Describe a time you tried something new.
scenes.say: Final task. Card: describe a time you tried something new. You have one minute to plan and then two minutes to speak. Start recording after the plan.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Karta: yangi narsani sinab ko‘rgan paytingizni tasvirlang. Avval bir daqiqa reja tuzing, to‘rtta katak va kalit so‘zlar bilan. Keyin telefonni yoqing va ikki daqiqa to‘xtamasdan gapiring. Rejaga qarab tuzilmani kuzating. Shu paytda pauza qilib turing, videoni to‘xtatmang. Hozir gapiring, taymer ishlayapti.
scenes.say_uz: Karta: yangi narsani sinab ko‘rgan paytingiz. Bir daqiqa reja, keyin ikki daqiqa gapirish.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni baholang
board: Did I finish with a reflection?
scenes.say: Check yourself with five questions. Did you use all four steps? Did you use three linkers? Did you keep going? Did you use collocations? Did you finish with a reflection?
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizni baholang. Beshta savol: to‘rtala qadamdan foydalandingizmi? Kamida uchta bog‘lovchi ishlatdingizmi? To‘xtamay gapirdingizmi? Bir nechta so‘z birikmasini ishlatdingizmi? Xulosa bilan tugatdingizmi? Hamma javob ha bo‘lsa, siz tayyorsiz. Aks holda, qaysi qadam yetishmaganini aniqlang va yana bir marta urinib ko‘ring. Ikkinchi urinish odatda birinchisidan sezilarli yaxshi chiqadi.
scenes.say_uz: Beshta savol bilan o‘zingizni tekshiring: qadamlar, bog‘lovchilar, to‘xtamaslik, birikmalar va xulosa.

scenes.title: Darsning xulosasi
board: 3 Linkers: to begin with, at that point, in the end
4 Keep going: fillers, describe, add a detail
scenes.say: Let's review. Plan for one minute with keywords. Follow the four steps. Use time phrases and linkers. And keep going with fillers, descriptions and extra details.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: bir daqiqa reja, to‘rtta katak, faqat kalit so‘zlar. Ikkinchi: to‘rt qadam, ya’ni vaziyat, tafsilot, his-tuyg‘u va xulosa. Uchinchi: vaqt iboralari va bog‘lovchilar, and then ni takrorlamang. To‘rtinchi: to‘xtamang, vaqt yutish iborasi ishlating, so‘zni tasvirlang va tafsilot qo‘shing. Bu usullar bilan har qanday kartada ikki daqiqa gapira olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: bir daqiqa reja, to‘rt qadam, bog‘lovchilar va to‘xtamaslik usullari.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: record 2 monologues (2 min each) on given cards
Card 1: a time you were proud
Check: 4 steps, 3 linkers, no long pauses
scenes.say: Your homework: record two monologues of two minutes each on the cards. Plan for one minute first. Then listen back and check the four steps and the linkers.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: berilgan ikkita kartaga ikkita ikki daqiqalik monolog yozib oling. Birinchi karta: o‘zingiz faxrlangan paytingiz. Ikkinchi karta: esda qolgan sayohatingiz. Har biridan oldin bir daqiqa reja tuzing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: to‘rtala qadam bor, kamida uchta bog‘lovchi ishlatilgan va uzoq pauza yo‘q. Keyingi darsda atrof-muhit va jamiyat mavzusini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: ikkita karta bo‘yicha ikkita ikki daqiqalik monolog yozing, avval bir daqiqa rejalang va yozuvni eshitib tekshiring.

homework_uz: Berilgan ikkita kartaga ikkita ikki daqiqalik monolog yozib oling. Har biridan oldin bir daqiqa reja tuzing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: to‘rtala qadam bor, kamida uchta bog‘lovchi ishlatilgan va uzoq pauza yo‘q.

quiz.q: What is the best way to use a one-minute plan?
quiz.why_uz: Reja faqat kalit so‘zlardan iborat bo‘lishi kerak.

options: I was boring in the lesson.
I was bored in the lesson.
I was bore in the lesson.
quiz.why_uz: His qilgan odam uchun -ed sifat: bored.

quiz.q: ___ we arrived, the shop had closed.
Which sentence is a good reflection?
options: Looking back, it taught me to stay calm.
quiz.why_uz: Looking back va it taught me xulosa uchun mos.
Fon uchun past continuous: it was raining.

quiz.q: You forget the word 'suitcase'. What is best?
options: Describe it: a big bag for clothes

quiz.why_uz: Well, let me think — tabiiy vaqt yutish iborasi.

options: I'd like to tell you about a time I got lost.
I don't know what to say.
